summary_en: This phase 4 study tests testosterone replacement therapy in men with low testosterone and localized prostate cancer who are on active surveillance. Testosterone is given by injection, gel, lotion, or transdermal patch, at the treating physician's discretion, with active surveillance for up to 5 years; dosing frequency is not stated. The main outcome measure is not stated; this is a phase 4 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 4 evalúa la terapia de reemplazo de testosterona en hombres con niveles bajos de testosterona y cáncer de próstata localizado que están en vigilancia activa. La testosterona se administra en inyección, gel, loción o parche transdérmico, a criterio del médico tratante, con vigilancia activa durante hasta 5 años; la frecuencia de dosis no se indica. El resultado principal no se indica; es un estudio de fase IV.
who_for: Localized prostate cancer eligible for active surveillance (NCCN very low, low, or intermediate favorable risk).
Able to understand the study and sign the written informed consent form.
not_for: NCCN intermediate unfavorable, high, or very high risk localized prostate cancer.
For the testosterone group: locally advanced or metastatic prostate cancer, or male breast cancer.
For the testosterone group: an active desire to have children.
For the testosterone group: hematocrit above 54%, or baseline hematocrit of 48-50%.
For the testosterone group: uncontrolled or poorly controlled congestive heart failure.
